newsitem.title: USA: Marriott says "strong performance" to continue.
newsitem.headline: Marriott says "strong performance" to continue.

text.p: Marriott International Inc, reporting higher second quarter results, said Thursday it expects its "strong performance" to continue.

J.W. Marriott Jr, chairman and chief executive officer of the hotel company, said its Marriott Lodging unit was benefitting from the expansion of its property portfolio, contributions from new properties throughout the world, and "very favorable conditions" in most segments of the U.S. hotel industry.
"Our ambitious new unit development programs are on track, and we are excited about the growth opportunities and synergies created by the Renaissance Hotel Group acquisition," it said.
